## About
Jim Suny's Auto Specialists is on West Chester Pike in Upper Darby. It's Jim's shop, and his son Greg is the one a lot of our customers get to know.
Our goal is simple: to exceed our customers' expectations for service. We want to give you good products and good work at reasonable prices, so you keep coming back and we get to know you and your car.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating from 58 Google reviews.

## Services
- Oil changes & Tune-ups: Routine oil changes and tune-ups to keep your car running right.
- Complete Engine Performance Check: A full look at how your engine is running.
- Engine Repair & Replacement: Engine repair, and replacement when it comes to that.
- Computer Diagnostics: Computer diagnostics to track down what's going on with your car.
- Air Conditioning Service & Repair: Service and repair for your car's air conditioning.
- Electrical System Diagnosis & Repair: Finding and fixing electrical problems.
- Brake System Repair: Brake repair, including brake lines.
- Suspension & Steering Service & Repair: Service and repair for your suspension and steering.

## FAQ
Q: Can you look over a used car before I buy it?
A: Yes. We do pre-purchase inspections, so you know what you're getting before you sign.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday mornings from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Can I email the shop?
A: Yes. You can reach Greg at greg@sunyautorepair.com or Jim at jim@sunyautorepair.com.
